{{Commodity infobox|iridium}}

'''Iridium''' is a market-traded cargo metal introduced in update 4.4.1.0 as one of the commodities associated with planetary surface mining.<ref name="rhino-update" /> INARA classifies it as a metal, lists it as produced by surface mining, and describes its industrial use in ship hulls and armour.<ref name="inara" /> It occupies cargo space rather than the separate [[Engineering Materials]] inventory.

== Acquisition ==

=== Planetary surface mining ===

Iridium can be recovered from Planetary Mining Locations using a [[Rhino]]. A ship's [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] identifies suitable locations from orbit, after which the Rhino locates and extracts buried deposits with its surface-mining equipment.<ref name="rhino-update" /><ref name="rhino-devlog">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-august-dev-log-2026 Elite Dangerous: August Dev Log 2026], Frontier Developments.</ref>

EDFM's current community prospecting dataset records Iridium on '''metal-rich''' and '''high-metal-content''' ground. These are observed occurrence rates from surveyed mining locations, not Frontier-published spawn rates or guaranteed yields.

{{#invoke:EDFM/SurfaceMining|material|iridium}}

See [[Surface Mining with the Rhino]] for equipment, prospecting, rig deployment, refining, and collection instructions. The commodity-specific deposit yield, refining conversion, capacity, and replenishment behavior have not yet been established.

=== Buying ===

Normal NPC production or purchase supply has not been established. Commodity services may display a reference buy price while reporting no actual stock, so confirm current supply, report age, landing-pad access, and carrier permissions before travelling.<ref name="inara" />

== Uses and selling ==

{{Commodity uses|iridium}}

Iridium can be sold to commodity markets with demand. INARA lists Military and High Tech economies as consumers and describes the metal as a material used in ship hulls and armour.<ref name="inara" /> Market prices and demand change, so check a current [https://inara.cz/elite/commodity/10489/ commodity-market listing] before choosing a buyer.
